sentences.text: The petitioner participated in the tender process commenced as per Ext.P1 notice for the conduct of a canteen attached to the District Hospital, Palakkad.
The fourth respondent was running the canteen in the previous year.

The case of the petitioner is that without finalising the tender process,
the fourth respondent, whose tender was found to be defective, is permitted to run the canteen indefinitely.
The petitioner, therefore, seeks appropriate directions in this regard, in this writ petition.
2. It is beyond dispute that the term for which the fourth respondent was awarded the right to conduct the canteen is over.
It is seen that Ext.P1 tender notice has been issued as early as on 22.02.2017.
In the circumstances, there is absolutely no justification for not finalising the tender process.

The writ petition is, therefore, disposed of directing the second respondent to finalise the tender process initiated pursuant to Ext.P1, within ten days from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

Sd/-
P.B. SURESH KUMAR JUDGE bpr
